reason: If you like the atmospheric production of Dark Side of the Moon, Random Access Memories explores similar electronic textures with a different palette.
Back to Black shares the same meticulous production values, but with a soul/R&B lens instead of progressive rock.
After the weight of Dune, Hitchhiker's Guide is the perfect palate cleanser — same sci-fi setting, opposite tone.
If you appreciate the complexity of the Margaux, try the Cloudy Bay for a completely different but equally well-crafted white.
After the intensity of Blade Runner 2049, The Big Lebowski is the perfect counterbalance — same era of LA, completely different energy.
